title: Add ref.mounted guards after awaits in manage_tutors_providers.dart's incomingTutorGrantsProvider
why: incomingTutorGrantsProvider watches `authStateProvider.select((s) => s.currentUser?.firebaseUid)` and then awaits two network/DB calls before touching `ref.read` three more times (lines 118, 124, 131). If the watched uid changes mid-flight (e.g. the tutor signs out while this fetch is in progress — the exact account-switch race this file's own comments say it must defend against), Riverpod 3 tears down this build invocation and a subsequent `ref.read` throws UnmountedRefException instead of the intended AsyncError/graceful outcome. No `ref.mounted` check guards any of the three post-await reads.
recommendation: Check `if (!ref.mounted) return const <TutorGrant>[];` (or equivalent) immediately after each await before touching ref again, mirroring the SM-4 pattern used elsewhere in Notifier methods.
acceptance_criteria: A test that invalidates authStateProvider's uid while incomingTutorGrantsProvider's future is pending does not throw UnmountedRefException.

corrections: The 'why' text's line list (118, 124, 131) is slightly off — 131 is an await, not a ref.read; the second post-await ref-touch is actually line 121 (ref: ref, passed to buildTutoredMirrorWipeService).
